version: v1
sharing:
  timeSlicing:
    resources:
      - name: nvidia.com/gpu
        replicas: 4

# Format
# If line starts with a '#' it is considered a comment
# DCGM FIELD, Prometheus metric type, help message

# Clocks
DCGM_FI_DEV_SM_CLOCK,  gauge, SM clock frequency (in MHz).
DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_CLOCK, gauge, Memory clock frequency (in MHz).

# Temperature
DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP, gauge, Memory temperature (in C).
DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP,    gauge, GPU temperature (in C).

# Power
DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE,              gauge, Power draw (in W).
DCGM_FI_DEV_TOTAL_ENERGY_CONSUMPTION, counter, Total energy consumption since boot (in mJ).

# PCIE
DCGM_FI_PROF_PCIE_TX_BYTES,  counter, Total number of bytes transmitted through PCIe TX via NVML.
DCGM_FI_PROF_PCIE_RX_BYTES,  counter, Total number of bytes received through PCIe RX via NVML.
DCGM_FI_DEV_PCIE_REPLAY_COUNTER, counter, Total number of PCIe retries.

# Utilization (the sample period varies depending on the product)
DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL,      gauge, GPU utilization (in %).
DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_COPY_UTIL, gauge, Memory utilization (in %).
DCGM_FI_DEV_ENC_UTIL,      gauge, Encoder utilization (in %).
DCGM_FI_DEV_DEC_UTIL,      gauge, Decoder utilization (in %).

# Errors and violations
DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS,            gauge,   Value of the last XID error encountered.

# Memory usage
DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE, gauge, Framebuffer memory free (in MiB).
DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED, gauge, Framebuffer memory used (in MiB).
DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_RESERVED, gauge, Framebuffer memory reserved (in MiB).

# VGPU License status
DCGM_FI_DEV_VGPU_LICENSE_STATUS, gauge, vGPU License status

# Remapped rows
DCGM_FI_DEV_UNCORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS, counter, Number of remapped rows for uncorrectable errors
DCGM_FI_DEV_CORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS,   counter, Number of remapped rows for correctable errors
DCGM_FI_DEV_ROW_REMAP_FAILURE,           gauge,   Whether remapping of rows has failed

# Static configuration information. These appear as labels on the other metrics
DCGM_FI_DRIVER_VERSION,        label, Driver Version

# DCP metrics
DCGM_FI_PROF_GR_ENGINE_ACTIVE,   gauge, Ratio of time the graphics engine is active.
DCGM_FI_PROF_PIPE_TENSOR_ACTIVE, gauge, Ratio of cycles the tensor (HMMA) pipe is active.
DCGM_FI_PROF_DRAM_ACTIVE,        gauge, Ratio of cycles the device memory interface is active sending or receiving data.
DCGM_FI_PROF_PCIE_TX_BYTES,      gauge, The rate of data transmitted over the PCIe bus - including both protocol headers and data payloads - in bytes per second.
DCGM_FI_PROF_PCIE_RX_BYTES,      gauge, The rate of data received over the PCIe bus - including both protocol headers and data payloads - in bytes per second.

set -eu
cd /opt/herdr
curl -fsSLo herdr "https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr/releases/download/$${HERDR_VERSION}/herdr-linux-x86_64"
curl -fsSLo ttyd "https://github.com/tsl0922/ttyd/releases/download/$${TTYD_VERSION}/ttyd.x86_64"
gh="gh_$${GH_VERSION#v}_linux_amd64"
curl -fsSL "https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/$${GH_VERSION}/$${gh}.tar.gz" | tar -xz --strip-components=2 "$${gh}/bin/gh"
chmod +x herdr ttyd gh
# Seed herdr's config on first boot only; herdr and Settings write to it later
mkdir -p /home/vscode/.config/herdr
[ -f /home/vscode/.config/herdr/config.toml ] || printf '[theme]\nname = "vesper"\n' > /home/vscode/.config/herdr/config.toml
if /opt/herdr/herdr status server | grep -q "status: running"; then exec /opt/herdr/herdr; else echo "herdr server is not running yet, reload this page in a few seconds"; sleep 5; fi

[INPUT]
  name tail
  alias kubernetes
  path /var/log/containers/*.log
  parser containerd
  tag kubernetes.*

[FILTER]
  name kubernetes
  alias kubernetes
  match kubernetes.*
  buffer_size 0
  merge_log on

  kube_tag_prefix kubernetes.var.log.containers.
  k8s-logging.parser on
  k8s-logging.exclude on
  namespace_labels off
  annotations on

[FILTER]
  name modify
  match kubernetes.*
  add source home-cluster

[FILTER]
  name nest
  match kubernetes.*
  wildcard pod_name
  operation lift
  nested_under kubernetes
  add_prefix k_

[FILTER]
  name nest
  match kubernetes.*
  operation lift
  nested_under k_labels
  add_prefix k_labels_

[FILTER]
  name modify
  match kubernetes.*
  rename k_labels_app.kubernetes.io/instance app
  rename k_labels_app.kubernetes.io/name app
  rename k_labels_app app
  rename k_labels_k8s-app app
  rename k_container_name app

[OUTPUT]
  Name http
  Match kubernetes.*
  host victoria-logs-server.observability.svc.cluster.local
  port 9428
  uri /insert/jsonline?_stream_fields=stream,k_namespace_name,k_pod_name,app&_msg_field=log&_time_field=date
  format json_lines
  json_date_format iso8601
  compress gzip

find /sys/class/net/*/device/driver/module/drivers -maxdepth 1 -path "*e1000e*" | awk -F'/' '{print $5}' | xargs -I% nsenter --mount=/host/proc/$(pidof /usr/local/bin/kubelet)/ns/mnt --net=/host/proc/$(pidof /usr/local/bin/kubelet)/ns/net -- sh -c "echo '% - BEFORE' && echo '==========' && ethtool -k % && echo '==========' && echo 'Disabling offloads for %...' && ethtool -K % tso off gso off gro off && echo '==========' && echo '% - AFTER' && echo '==========' && ethtool -k % && echo '=========='" && sleep infinity

dir /data
appendonly yes
save ""
rename-command FLUSHDB ""
rename-command FLUSHALL ""

targets:
  # Public DNS Servers (IPv4)
  - hosts:
      - 1.1.1.1              # Cloudflare Primary
      - 1.0.0.1              # Cloudflare Secondary
      - 8.8.8.8              # Google Primary
      - 8.8.4.4              # Google Secondary
      - 9.9.9.9              # Quad9 Primary
      # 149.112.112.112 is used for WAN2 gateway monitoring in OPNsense
    interval: 1s
    network: ip4
    protocol: icmp
    size: 56

  # Internet Services
  - hosts:
      - google.com
      - github.com
      - cnn.com
      - ghcr.io
    interval: 1s
    network: ip4
    protocol: icmp
    size: 56

metadata_dir = "/meta"
data_dir = "/data"
db_engine = "lmdb"
metadata_auto_snapshot_interval = "6h"

replication_factor = 1
rpc_bind_addr = "0.0.0.0:3901"
rpc_public_addr = "127.0.0.1:3901"

[s3_api]
# Mastodon signs for us-east-1 by default, and Garage rejects signatures for
# any region other than this one.
s3_region = "us-east-1"
api_bind_addr = "0.0.0.0:3900"

# Anonymous public reads go through the web endpoint (S3 API has no anonymous access).
# A request whose Host isn't under root_domain is looked up as a bucket alias, so
# the bucket carries the CDN origin hostname as a second global alias.
[s3_web]
bind_addr = "0.0.0.0:3902"
root_domain = ".web.garage.internal"
index = "index.html"

[admin]
api_bind_addr = "0.0.0.0:3903"

set -euo pipefail
api=http://127.0.0.1:3903/v2
# Responses are pretty-printed; strip whitespace so they can be matched with grep.
get() { wget -q -O - --header "Authorization: Bearer $GARAGE_ADMIN_TOKEN" "$api/$1" | tr -d ' \n'; }
post() { wget -q -O - --header "Authorization: Bearer $GARAGE_ADMIN_TOKEN" --header "Content-Type: application/json" --post-data "$2" "$api/$1"; }

until get GetClusterStatus >/dev/null 2>&1; do echo "waiting for admin API"; sleep 2; done

if get GetClusterLayout | grep -q '"roles":\[\]'; then
  node=$(get GetClusterStatus | grep -o '"id":"[0-9a-f]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)
  version=$(get GetClusterLayout | grep -o '"version":[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d: -f2)
  echo "assigning node $node and applying layout v$((version + 1))"
  post UpdateClusterLayout "{\"roles\":[{\"id\":\"$node\",\"zone\":\"dc1\",\"capacity\":$LAYOUT_CAPACITY,\"tags\":[]}]}" >/dev/null
  post ApplyClusterLayout "{\"version\":$((version + 1))}" >/dev/null
fi

# usage: ensure_key <name> <id> <secret>
ensure_key() {
  if ! get "GetKeyInfo?id=$2" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "importing key $1"
    post ImportKey "{\"accessKeyId\":\"$2\",\"secretAccessKey\":\"$3\",\"name\":\"$1\"}" >/dev/null
  fi
}

bucket_id() { get "GetBucketInfo?globalAlias=$1" | grep -o '"id":"[0-9a-f]\{64\}"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4; }

# usage: ensure_bucket <bucket> <key id>
ensure_bucket() {
  if ! get "GetBucketInfo?globalAlias=$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "creating bucket $1"
    post CreateBucket "{\"globalAlias\":\"$1\"}" >/dev/null
  fi
  post AllowBucketKey "{\"bucketId\":\"$(bucket_id "$1")\",\"accessKeyId\":\"$2\",\"permissions\":{\"read\":true,\"write\":true,\"owner\":true}}" >/dev/null
}

ensure_key mastodon "$MASTODON_KEY_ID" "$MASTODON_KEY_SECRET"
ensure_bucket mastodon "$MASTODON_KEY_ID"

id=$(bucket_id mastodon)
if ! get "GetBucketInfo?globalAlias=$WEB_HOST" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "aliasing bucket mastodon as $WEB_HOST"
  post AddBucketAlias "{\"bucketId\":\"$id\",\"globalAlias\":\"$WEB_HOST\"}" >/dev/null
fi
post "UpdateBucket?id=$id" '{"websiteAccess":{"enabled":true,"indexDocument":"index.html"}}' >/dev/null

echo "bootstrap complete"
trap 'exit 0' TERM
while :; do sleep 3600 & wait $!; done

dir /data
appendonly yes
save ""
rename-command FLUSHDB ""
rename-command FLUSHALL ""

generic:
  enabled: true
  outbound: false
  allowJsTransformationFunctions: true
  waitForComplete: false
